title: The 4 Kingdom Laws For Overcoming Crisis
paragraphs: When I say you will not succeed, it is because life is predictable. For the first time last week, on Tuesday, the British government used the word recession. Last week, on Thursday, the U. S. government officially used the word " recession" for the first time. France was a little more forthright. The French president used the word two weeks ago when they were meeting as the G7 to talk about the state of the world. The French president said: "Look, let's be honest. We are in a state of stagnation."

The average Bahamian citizen knows nothing but that word. To enter a recession means to stop and decline. When you use this word in relation to economics, it means that economics did exactly that. It stopped growing and began to decline and shrink. When the economy enters a recession, the next word you do n't want to hear is depression. The last time the world experienced a recession was after World War II. They have been using this word in the corridors of power for the past week.

The Bahamas have always been, please excuse the word, lucky. I say luck because I still don't know how God blessed us to survive the Depression of the 1930s. This was during the time when Castro decided to take the path of socialism. It was only thanks to his decision that the Bahamas became an alternative tourist destination, since Cuba was the top tourist destination before Castro became a socialist. So our economy was built on another man's mistake. 90% of our jobs depend on tourism, including money in banks.

Even our banking system is dependent on tourism, because when you deposit your salary from taxis, hotels, or any work you do in the hay market, it goes into the bank. The bank has an owner who is not really money. It's just a piece of paper. We are extremely fragile. Recession means that the very foundations of the global system are collapsing. This is not the time to act with artificial intelligence, and this is not the time for repeated slogans. The slogans mean "Blessed be the Lord". Hallelujah. I'm fine. No no.

It's best if you know some facts now. Saying "I am blessed" will not help. You have to experience the blessing for yourself. The Kingdom of God is real. It is a country. It's real. It has all the components of a state, including an economy. The world's economies are collapsing from within. Do you know what they say is the primary reason behind the worsening recession among the peoples of the world? Because of another word: fear. Fear is defined as, please listen carefully, it is defined as a lack of confidence.

In other words, when consumers lose confidence in the system, they stop participating in it. They stop buying things. Consumer confidence is important for the functioning of capitalist economies because everything in the world economy is based on people buying and selling. If people stop buying, you stop selling. When you stop selling, you have inventory. Inventory always costs you. And that's how fear arises. This leads me to my third, very important point. The world calls it a crisis.

Let everyone say it's a crisis. I love the Japanese. The Japanese will be fine, even though they sometimes react rashly to crises. But the Chinese word for crisis is the same as the word for opportunity. So when you tell the Chinese that things are in crisis, they actually say it this way. We have a great opportunity. No, that's why wherever the Chinese go, even in slums, they end up owning a business and you work for them. What you call a problem, they call an opportunity. So we don't panic.

The people of the kingdom must think differently. When the world says fear, we say faith. When the world says crisis, we say opportunity. But you need to think differently. This leads to point number four. Crisis is a source of creativity. When there is innovation, it is usually the result of a crisis. Humans have always progressed under pressure. Your parents told you years ago that necessity is the mother of invention.

What your mother meant by that is that when you have to do something, you will find a way to do it. If you lose your job, I know you'll eat somehow. You will find a way to feed these children. Crisis is a breeding ground for innovation. Crisis is a breeding ground for creativity. Now is the time to use the mind that God has given you. Sitting around and wishing things would change won't help you anymore. Our governments are bankrupt of ideas about what to do.

Did you know that the world's five most powerful countries don't know what to do? I was just in London a few hours ago, and over the course of two days I watched the pound drop from two dollars to 1. 58 in a matter of days. It is collapsing right before our eyes. They don't know what they should do. Prime Minister Mr. Brown said: "We don't know what to do. We are conducting experiments." He says, "When smart people don't know what to do, it's best to associate with someone smarter. Please write this down.

The Kingdom of Heaven never faces a crisis. Say Amen. Say it out loud. Say it out loud. Amen. I was speaking to a minister in England. He said church members are coming to him. Thirty percent of them have lost their jobs in the last two weeks. So our donations are in jeopardy. He says, ' We can't even pay the weekly rent for the building where we hold the service.' He said, ' What do I do?'" "I said: " You need to hold meetings with your members and start talking about creativity."

A priest told me a few months ago, when the crisis hit, "I have to mortgage my house to save the church." My wife did not agree to that. I don't blame her, but he's trying to save the church building. These are true stories. In the kingdom of God, there is no crisis. God has never let his people down, but you must make sure that you are one of his people. Please keep your eyes open. Please, this is a very serious morning because I'm telling you, in the next seven or eight days, this is going to come to a head.

I think we need to remember that the citizens of the Kingdom grow in times of crisis. Everywhere you read history, whenever there is trouble, the citizens of the kingdom expand, and persecution expands God's people just as heat expands yeast. Therefore, this is the best time for us to take advantage of opportunities. But we need to learn some things first. I want to present this to you in the most serious way possible. The secret keys to the kingdom must be put into effect. Now please write this down.

This is extremely important. I have come with a message for you. Jesus said that the keys that will help you succeed are secret keys. Secret keys. This means that what you have learned will not help you. There is some other information he wants you to have so that you can conquer the world. Systems, think about it. Everything they taught you in the banks is useless. Insurance companies, insurance companies are collapsing. Financial institutions that underwrite insurance companies are collapsing.

Companies that guarantee bank mortgages are collapsing. Even the best graduates from Yale and Harvard don't know what to do. It would be better for you to get more information. Yes, sir. You know, I constantly ask our local bankers: "So, what will happen to our money?" They say, "We will be fine. You will be fine." What do you mean by saying we will be fine if we depend on a monster and this monster is sick? Be honest with us. We need more information.

My job as a pastor of the church is not to give you a false or strange idea that you will get through this crisis easily. I want you to be strong, but with true knowledge. Let me tell you something. Jesus did say something about crises. Do you know that when they asked Congress, please listen to me, look at me, look at me, please don't get distracted. When they asked Congress four weeks ago, they called in the chairman of the Federal Reserve, sat him down, and said to him, " What caused this?

What caused the entire economy to collapse? What caused all the banks to collapse? What caused this? " The man used a word from the Bible, but everyone in the church overlooked it. He said that the reason for the collapse of everything is one word: greed. He used the word. He says it's because of greed. Am I right? You are the Vice President. They said that in this system, officials have become greedy. Let me read something to you. Write this down. What is greed? Please write this down.

Greed is the mismanagement of resources for personal gain. Every word is important. Firstly, it is a mismanagement of resources for personal gain. This means you don't care who gets hurt in this process. You wonder why people are losing their homes by the thousands. 3,000 homes are lost every week in America. In a week. They estimate that by the end of 2009, more than two million homes will have been lost. People are living in their cars because a few people at the top have become greedy.

Let's read what the Bible says about greed. Mark, Chapter 7, The Words of Jesus. He says: "Greed, malice, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, pride, and foolishness. All these evils come from within and make a person unclean." Greed is at the top of the list. Greed is when you want more than you need. At anyone else's expense. Greed means that I know I only need one pillow, but I want 10. I need one plate, but I want 20. That is greed. Poor resource management.

Ladies and gentlemen, I also like what the Apostle Paul said about greed. He said, "It's a curse." But look at the Gospel of Luke, chapter twelve. Jesus said, " Then he said to them, 'Be careful.'" Be careful. Interesting. He speaks to us against all forms of greed. Note that he used the word "beware". " Beware" means that this could happen to you. You don't even realize that you are greedy. And here you are. You have a working car, but you see someone else with a nicer car and you don't need it now.

But now you say that the Lord can bless you. No, you don't need the car. What do you mean by the Lord blessing you? You are falling into debt. You call it a blessing, and God calls it religion. The car you own has already been paid for. But you see another car owned by another believer, and you don't know what he went through to get it, so you want it, and greed creeps into you, and you call that a blessing. God calls it a curse. Look at the words he used. He says: " Beware." Be careful.

You know, this is a difficult thing to do. Some of you women, please don't take it personally today. I am speaking to you in the spirit of reckoning and righteousness. Some of the things you pursue, you will not need. Wear those shoes for a little longer. This is not the time to talk about keeping up with fashion. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. I... this is serious now. Look, when you're going through a crisis, you have to be careful. Protect yourself. He says: " Beware of greed."

Greed can destroy an entire country. Look at the following words. Jesus says: "A person's life is not made up of the abundance of their possessions." He got straight to the heart of the matter. He says: Look, greed is wanting everything you see that you don't need. I will never forget the day I went to visit the late John Templeton in Lifford Cay in the Bahamas. A beautiful place where the wealthy live. I entered his office. He greeted me and kissed me.

And there was this old man, one of the richest men in the world. He went out wearing shorts with holes in them. He was wearing navy shoes, those athletic shoes full of holes. He was wearing a wild jacket that looked, you know, dirty. He hugged me and smiled. I am embracing Mr. Templeton, owner of the Templeton Foundation. Billions of dollars. He came and took me through his small office. The office was so small that I could barely find a place to sit. He spoke to me.

He used to donate one million dollars annually to theologians. I said to myself, if this is bohemian, then shoes made of snakeskin, crocodile skin, and tiger shapes. It is amazing that people who own nothing dress as if they own everything when they own nothing. They do not understand that your life is not measured by possessions. Let's talk about the Kingdom in light of the crises. Let me just say this. Listen to me. I come to you by the word of the Lord. Jesus said, "Write this down."

The citizens of the Kingdom are not immune to crises. As you know, we have this idea, well, I am in the kingdom of God. You cannot touch me. Oh, yes. I think there is a difference between being in the storm and being saved in the middle of the storm. Here are the words of Jesus. He said, "Whoever hears these words of mine and acts upon them, what? Practice." This is the key. This is the right time for you to put the affairs of the Kingdom into practice.

He says, "Everyone who hears these words of mine and acts accordingly," look at the following phrase. He says, "What?" It is like a wise man who built his house on rock. Now look at this. The rain came down, the rivers rose, the winds blew, and battered that house. However, it did not fall. I was shocked by that house. I was shocked by that house. I was shocked by that house. Just because your house is built on the principles of the Kingdom doesn't mean it wo n't be attacked.

That storm did not discriminate between houses. Was safety the only thing that was fundamental? The same storm hit all the houses. Look at this. He says it didn't fall because there's a reason its foundation is on the rock. A reference to the words of the Kingdom of God. But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not act upon them, that is what this session is about. It's time to apply. It doesn't work.

He says that the storm comes, the rain falls, the rivers rise, the winds blow and strike that house, and it falls, and its fall is great. Ladies and gentlemen, I am here to announce to you that we are in the midst of a storm. She's not just coming. Our only means of survival is the principles of the Kingdom of God, the Word of God. Now, I want to give you something I call the keys. Jesus said these words. In Matthew 16, I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. This means accessibility.

If I gave you a key to my house today, what would I have given you? Accessibility. What else did I give you? power. I have given you the authority. I have given you control of my house. He said: I will give you the keys. Note that the word is not a key in the singular, but keys in the plural, which means there are many different rooms that you need to open. The Kingdom of Heaven is a country, and there are many principles by which it operates.

He said: I will give you the keys to the kingdom, so whatever you open on earth, heaven will be forced to open for you. Whatever you close on earth, heaven will close for you. In other words, I will give you the power to decide what happens on the ground. We know what the economists are saying. We know what governments say. We know what the reports say. Tourism decreased by 5%. Hotels are closing their doors. Two-day work week, you know, job losses, closures, banks downsizing, and some collapsing.

God says: Well, you'd better use other keys. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. If the system on the ground isn't working, he says: You'd better have the keys to unlock that other country. Yes, sir. Look at this. Mark 4:1. He said to them, “The secret of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to those outside.” Therefore, I speak to them in riddles and proverbs. He said: Look, this is very important. He says: You will live in this world, but I will give you some secrets. Okay, look at me for a second.

Ah, can you come here, Marquin? Well, Marquin and I are on the same level. We stand on the same level. We are in the same place. He said: Look, I will tell you secrets that I will not tell him. He is outside the kingdom even though we are in the same place. So, you have information that he doesn't have. So when a crisis hits us, boom, our responses are different because I know something. But he doesn't know him. So he gets depressed and I start dancing. He is drowning in fear and I am beginning to practice faith.

Yes, sir. He said, "I will lose and say that I will be fine." We are now in the same place, at the same level, in the same situation, but with two different responses. Why? Because of the information. Read the verse again. That's exactly what he's telling us. He says: " Look, you are not like them." Not because you are not with them. You are with them, but you are not like them. The only difference between you and them is some information. The secret of the Kingdom of Heaven.

What I want to leave with you today, and I will complete this tomorrow, or perhaps not tomorrow, but next week, because we must understand this matter correctly if you want to succeed. Thank you very much. He says: "I will give you the secrets of the kingdom, not to those outside." Do you remember David? King David, David experienced this, as you know, David says: “If you follow the righteousness of God, a thousand will fall from your right hand.” Yes, sir.

Ten thousand will fall to your left, but will not come near you. Now, he does n't mean, notice now that it falls to your right and your left. Look how close he is to falling. You will be in the middle of that. He said: But the way it will affect you will be different because of your position in the kingdom. Say Hallelujah. Some of you will receive calls this week. You need to adopt a different mindset. Otherwise you will become depressed.

That is why God sent you here today to put you in your place, so that a thousand may fall on your right and a thousand on your left, but your position and status in the Kingdom will not allow the matter to affect you. Thanks. The crisis. Here is a key I want to leave with you today and I will continue this next week. I have to, I follow the instructions. This key is the most important key. I call it the master key to the kingdom. The main key to the kingdom that the King of Heaven gave to mankind. Write it down.

This is the key. It is the key that will save you for the next twelve months. I have read it. I brought with me a copy of the Telegraph from London, the main newspaper that deals with economics and economic affairs. They said this crisis will last for 5 years, and we may start to get out of it after 5 years. Don't say " Well, things might get better, " listen to me, don't fool yourselves, no, no, listen, we're going to be hit hard. Ladies and gentlemen, if the dollar collapses, listen to me carefully.

Let me step back because some of you need to hear this from the Bahamas. When U. S. tourism figures declined last month, the tourism ministry said: "Let's go to Europe." I just got back from Europe 5 hours ago. The pound has already fallen to 1. 50, which means that in England they have said: "We will not travel." So, what kind of plans do you have? What kind of plans do you have? You are planning for people who cannot come. I am speaking to all of you. Hope is empty if it is not accompanied by faith.

Faith is the essence. Well, we hope things will change. This is not enough. You need faith somewhere here. You need someone who believes in something different. Faith must be mixed with hope. We hope things will improve. Did you hear that? The first key to the kingdom that I want to present to you today is management. It is God's first key. Amen. Amen. Tell the administration. Say it again. Say it out loud. Do you know that this is why we are in trouble? Mismanagement due to greed. Yes, sir. You will succeed.

If you understand the message, management. The first principle that God gave to Adam was management. Let me give you a few things to remember. First, the main task given to humanity is to control the Earth's resources, not the people. Remember the birds, the fish, the livestock, the plants, and the animals. Then God said to Adam, “Gold is good, resin is good, and agate is good.” He told him that every kind of fruit was there for him to eat. He gave him the resources. He told him to take control of the resources.

The word control means responsibility for managing Earth's resources. This is what God created you to do: manage the Earth's resources. God’s divine purpose for all of us is to spread His culture on Earth, which is a culture of abundance. But he says you should do it through management. Managing Earth's resources is God's first command. They seized control of the Earth's resources. That's management. He has given us the responsibility to manage the products of this planet. I present this to you, my friends.

I don't know how we would succeed if we went to heaven now, because can you imagine that? He says the streets are paved with gold. Do you see those greedy people tearing up pieces of God's rocks from the streets? We will be scattered everywhere on Earth. You have received your piece. I got my piece. We are destroying God's way. Why? Because some of you associate wealth with these things that God has placed on earth. In the sky, there will be gates of pearl. Pearls. Pearls, my brother. Take that.

Place it on your back. She sits behind those pearl gates. God said, "Where are you going?" I'll be back right away. The things we pursue, God uses as building materials. You know, I don't believe there are streets of gold in the sky. I do not believe in the existence of gates, because the Bible does not mention any buildings. I think what John was trying to convey was that the place was full of riches. The entire atmosphere is so rich that the things we crave, God throws onto the earth.

He said, " Pray that it may come to earth." Not the things themselves, but the atmosphere, the environment in which there is abundance for everyone. The only way to survive is to understand this divine strategy of God, management through action. I want to explain to you the meaning of work. The word for work is " Aragon," which means to become. God wants you to use the Earth's resources to add value to yourself, not to harm others. The more valuable you become, the more resources will be attracted to you.

I want to share this with you this morning because I believe that the essence of surviving this crisis is how you manage your affairs. How do you manage it? Genesis 4:2. Everyone should read it. Let's go. Verse four. When the Lord God created the earth and the heavens, the bush of righteousness had not yet appeared on the earth, nor had the grass of righteousness sprouted. Why? Because the Lord had not sent down rain on the earth. Why? Because there was no human being to manage the earth. Okay, listen to me.

This is very important. The land was full of life, but it was barren. The verse says that God withheld the rain. He refused to allow anything to grow. Please listen to me. He refused to allow anything to proceed. No growth, development, or expansion was permitted. Why? He was looking for a manager. God could provide for you right now, but He is waiting. Prayer is not what God is looking for. Singing is not what he is looking for. Cheering is not what he is looking for.

Prayer, no, it's looking to see if you can manage what it wants to give you. Can you imagine that the blessing depends on your ability to manage it? Here are some ideas you might want to write down. The word "work" actually means management. In Hebrew, it amazed me. He says: "God did not allow anything to grow because there was no manager to run the earth." Let me tell you something you may not have thought about before. So, the reason behind God creating man, can I say it again?

The motive, the reason for which God created man on Earth, and the reason, motive, and need that made God create humans on Earth was not for worship. He did not need a worshipper. The sky is full of that. He needed a manager. It's a difficult thing. Here are some of the results. Please write it down. Firstly, management is the primary goal of humanity. Secondly, whatever you fail to manage, you will lose. I will say this again, from the bottom of my heart. Whatever you fail to manage, you will lose.

If you fail to manage your body, you will lose your health. If you fail to manage your marriage, you will lose your spouse. If you fail to manage your money, you will lose all of it. If you fail to manage the home you live in, you will have to rent again. God does not allow any growth until he sees the management. The third point is very serious. God's primary measure of trust in you is management. He will only entrust you with what you can manage.

The fourth point is perhaps the most frustrating, which is that God only gives to effective management. If he sees a manager who is running effectively, he will give him more things. Amen. Amen. Amen. Amen. The fifth point is one that everyone here who wants to succeed should take note of. Management attracts resources. Say it. Say it out loud. Management attracts resources. Say it again. Management is attractive. Let me tell you something. I will now make a statement to the entire world.

For everyone who watches television. Here is the announcement. They say there is no money. I have an announcement to make. Not a single cent has left this planet. All the money that was here is still on the ground. Now the Bible says that God knows where the hidden treasures of darkness lie. The money on the ground is attracted to management. The money is still here. Yes. Money runs away from mismanagement. That's why everything collapsed.

Greedy CEOs granted loans that people could not afford because they wanted high commissions. God said, "If you finish the whole thing, boom." The money ran away, and nobody knows where it went. Now they print money that has no value. Listen, if you're going to get through this crisis, you'd better start by managing your bedroom. Clean the floor. Let God see your closet tidy. Did you make your bed before you left, my son? That's management. Anything you fail to manage, God will take away from you.

The rain will not come anymore. You will have a barren desert. There is no time to waste money or materials. It's best to start managing your salary. You have a choice between food and shoes. Forget about the shoes. Wear those old shoes for another three months. Why? You have to manage that money. We... O Lord. Complete. Complete. We tell you what we want. We want God to create magic instead of management. Here's the hardest thing I'm going to present to you this morning.

God will never give you what you ask for, only what you can manage. Yes, sir. That's why your prayer wasn't answered. Oh God, I want a million dollars. God says you cannot pay tithes out of a hundred. You cannot manage 10%. $100 and you want a million. Let me just make you write it like this. I call it management and prayer. God will give you not what you pray for, but what you can manage. You pray that God will give you a job. God says, " Well, in your previous job, you were going in late every day."

You used to take two hours for lunch every day. She stole the man's time. You were leaving five minutes before five instead of five-thirty. And you were lying. You say you are sick, but you are not sick. How can I give you another job? Oh God. You are praying to God. Oh God, I need a home. God says: You are not keeping the place you live in clean while you are renting it. You are praying to God. Oh God, I need a car. God says: You don't clean your bicycle. In other words, you are not managing what you own now.

How can I give you something bigger to mismanage? Oh God, I want a wife. He said: You don't even pray alone. I will not talk about praying with my wife. Do not remain silent now. As you can see, he will give it to the administration. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. We love to pray. God says, "Now, I will withhold the rain until I see the administration." Let me give you a word that you may not have thought about before. Everyone should write this word, especially mothers and fathers. This word "economy" is a big word.

You hear it all the time. People don't understand what this word means. I thought I'd simplify it for you. When I was in university and we studied economics, I was shocked to learn that economics simply meant maximizing the minimum. This is what it means when you reduce it to its simplest definition. To be frugal means to take a little and make the most of it. This is correct.

So if you want to be an economic expert, you take one apple and turn it into a tree, then produce apples that you sell, and then make more apples from the seeds of the apples that came from the tree. So I received a salary of $500. God said, " Okay, turn this amount into 5,000." "Oh, you must be joking." Oh God, I need to eat some fatty food. You go straight to the restaurant and buy some food. Boom. Go and buy shoes you don't need. Go and buy some clothes while God says, "Wait a minute." The money did not double.

You, the consumer, have consumed it. You've wasted it on your personal desires. So God takes the job. Remember that God gave three people some talents. Talents here mean money. The first took the five and made it ten. The second took the four and made it eight. The next took the one, just buried it, wasted it, and hid it. He came and took it from that one and gave it to the one who had the most. Why? Because He wants more. He doesn't want less. That's economy.

It's a good time to go through your closet and find those clothes you haven't worn in a long time and start investing in them. Donate them. It's a good time to find some shoes you haven't worn in a long time. Say, "God, I'm not going to buy any more shoes for the next 12 months." I will wear these shoes. I will bring this back into service. Why? I will make the most of it. Whatever they say about my shoes, I will walk in my shoes. I will ask God to help me. I will attract resources. Praise God. I say: " Shout!"

Hallelujah. Look at my wife taking notes. Make notes twice about this point. No, she is a good woman. She doesn't waste money. She lives with me. We are not wasting money. I know where all my money goes. Carefully invested. To be frugal means to make the most of what you have. Is this what you do? To be frugal means to add value to your talent. You were born with a talent. You need to add value to it. Make it more valuable.

Economics means that God will not answer your prayers unless you organize them with management. The response to prayer is subject to your ability to manage it. God says, “ Well, you pray for your business to expand. Now let’s see how you manage what you already have if you’re going to get through this crisis. Remember, the resources are still on Earth, and God knows where they are, but He won’t deliver them to you if you don’t manage them well. And remember, whatever you mismanage, you will lose.

That’s why so many people will feel pressured, because they didn’t manage well in good times. Sailor, write down this last sentence. God doesn’t encourage wastefulness. Remember when there were 5,000 hungry people? And Jesus decided to feed them. And He performed a wonderful miracle. He made them all sit in an orderly fashion. Of course, it had to be organized. Then He broke the fish and bread, and everyone ate. Well, we love that part of the story. But we forget the most important part at the end.

He said, ‘ Now go and gather up all the crumbs and bring them to me.’ In other words, I don’t waste. Yes, sir. Some of you will go to a banquet after this service, and you must remember this sermon. You must decide what you are going to do with your resources. In the next few months, your money will be depleted.” Because its value is decreasing. This means that everything you spend should be something you need, not just something you want.

I say to you married people here, especially those of you with dreams of achieving certain things: Listen, don't pressure each other. If you ca n't afford something now, don't buy it. In fact, even if you can afford it, don't buy it. Not now. You need to be more decisive in your spending. Look, God hates waste. Here's a verse I think you haven't seen before: Psalm 115. Blessed be the Lord. Blessed be the Creator of heaven and earth. Verse 16 of Psalm 115. Heaven is the Lord's, but to whom has he given the earth?

To humankind. Let everyone say: Mandate. Write that down. Mandate. The earth is your legal domain. And humankind has been given sovereignty over the earth as a legal resource. Now remember, God did not give you ownership. He gave you the authority to manage it. And never confuse management with ownership. If someone gives you the right to manage something without owning it, then Your title is manager. So I'll put it this way. What is a manager? This is the most important definition you will ever write.

I studied this in university, but I had to improve the definition because I derived it from the Bible. Management is, please write that down. Everyone, every banker, write this down. Every investor, write this down. Everyone who owns a business, write this down. That's it. That's what I've always wanted to know.

Management is the efficient, effective, correct, and timely use of another person's property or resources for the purpose for which they have been entrusted, with the aim of producing the expected added value.
